items.q: Well, he'd carry that, then usually Bud would carry the bass. Because Bud, for being a guitar player, I'd carry his guitar.

ctx.x: as a kid, how'd you do about lugging that thing around? Well, I didn't carry it.

What happened? Usually, one fella'd carried a box, a soap box. Remember those wooden boxes, milk boxes, magnolia milk and all that? Well, he'd carry that, then usually Bud would carry the bass. Because Bud, for being a guitar player, I'd carry his guitar. Was he huskier than you were? Oh, yeah. Bud was a big man. He weighed all of 185 pounds for 5'10".
